title: VR : Obedience is Pleasure & My Sweet Boy (Obedience is Pleasure (2D))
description: Here is the fifth in the series of Virtual Reality (VR) files, that are voiced by me and produced in collaboration with my partnership with VRhythm. This time, for one of my newer files Obedience is Pleasure: An HFO Journey. And, as an extra bonus, you get access to the full 3D VR version of the previously released ASMR My Sweet Boy which you can use with VR goggles and experience my voice in your ears like never before. Exclusive for my supporters on the Hypnoslave tier (and above) is the 2D version of the file. Patreon Link The full 3D VR video is available on VRhythm's site. As well as the usual array of VR hub outlets. VRPorn Note: It is with great pleasure that I can announce I've partnered up with VRhythm. These VR videos are just the beginning of what I have in mind, so stay tuned. I'd love to hear what you think of this and what you'd like to see us do next! And, if you are interested in following VRhythm's work more closely, check out his Discord Server: https://discord.gg/S82Fq2cq9c
author: Mistress Shibby
